purpose: Apples-to-apples successor discriminator: run the exact same 24 compiled prompts that failed on Standard FLUX and succeeded on gemini-2.5-flash-image through gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image via the Google Gemini API directly, not fal.ai.
prompt_policy: Compile from the exact same current recipe/compiler state; do not add model-specific semantic wording so model is the main changed variable.

expected.note: Input text token charges are additional but small relative to image output cost.

decision_gate.diagnostic: Compare directly with output/semantic_anchor_revalidation_24_v1 (FLUX) and output/gemini25_direct_batch_24_v1 (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image). If 3.1 Flash Lite preserves the strong prompt-following of 2.5 Flash Image closely enough, recommend it as the production candidate (cheaper, non-deprecated). If meaningfully worse, recommend testing gemini-3.1-flash-image next before any bulk-generation decision.
decision_gate.pipeline_check: Manifest must preserve canonical ID, exact final prompt, batch job name, response index/metadata key, and image filename so prompt-to-image mapping is auditable.
